name: Bug report
about: An indicator, map or provenance panel is wrong

---

**District**
Name and administrative level. Note if it is multi-part, such as Greater London or New York City.

**Time windows**
Both observation windows, and confirm they are the same season.

**Indicator**
Surface water, vegetation, or built-up area.

**Expected vs actual**
What the value should have been and what was shown.

**Provenance shown**
Paste the scene IDs, coverage percentage, algorithm version and parameter hash from the evidence sheet. If the value rendered without provenance, say so - that is itself the bug.
